purpose: Expected acceptance population; this file records no passing observations.
populationRule: Cartesian product of every railApp and sideSurface with every theme and viewport. A slot key is surface/theme/widthxheight. Compare the live app registry with railApps before interpreting any result. Unexpected or missing registry entries require reconciliation, not silent exclusion.

assertions: primary and unpin hit targets separate
controls and prose contained at host width

stateCases.proof: real pointer and keyboard activation without an outward action
read source decision and visible unavailable explanation; no desktop launch or call
rendered loading state or relevant existing component fixture, explicitly identified
live empty state when available; otherwise an identified fixture, never invented live emptiness
timestamp/status presentation and a complete observed refresh, with unavailable readings distinguished
compare displayed claim to its source fields and read disabled/reconciling/unavailable explanations
compare starting and final theme/app/dock/panel/dialog state; no call, send, decision, or verdict mutation

completenessRule: Every expected slot has exactly one disposition. A missing/unreadable/duplicate-key/wrong-target capture, unexplained not-applicable row, unmatched requested test file, or unmeasured release is unknown or fail. File count alone never establishes coverage. Test fixtures cannot be relabeled as live evidence.
